assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cărtărescu's visionary prose gives memory, embodiment and historical experience an unusually expansive formal architecture; the novels named suggest a coherent metaphysical project rather than isolated virtuosity.
assessment.attribution: The citation can credit Mircea Cărtărescu alone for densely patterned visionary fiction that recasts memory and the body as an imaginative world-system.
assessment.maturity: The achievement appears sustained across fiction and poetry and has accumulated the breadth appropriate to recognition of a whole oeuvre.
uncertainties: The assessment depends substantially on translation and on incomplete direct coverage of the Romanian-language corpus.
The relative weight of his poetry within the total achievement requires further consideration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Yan Lianke has developed grotesque, mythic and structurally audacious fiction capable of confronting ideology, development and historical violence without reducing fiction to reportage.
assessment.attribution: Yan Lianke can be credited alone for a fiction that transforms the pressures of Chinese history into morally searching, formally inventive narrative.
assessment.maturity: The representative novels indicate a substantial and varied body of work with a sustained capacity for formal renewal.
uncertainties: Translation limits access to the tonal and linguistic force of the Chinese originals.
A fuller assessment should test the consistency of the oeuvre beyond its most internationally visible novels.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carson's work makes scholarship, lyric, drama, narrative and visual arrangement mutually active, producing a singular intellectual and emotional register in works such as Autobiography of Red and Nox.
assessment.attribution: The award would properly name Anne Carson alone for a multigenre oeuvre that reimagines classical materials and the possibilities of lyric thought.
assessment.maturity: Her achievement has persisted across forms and periods, with formal risk matched by a recognizable and durable artistic intelligence.
uncertainties: The balance between formally experimental work and the broader Nobel criterion of sustained literary significance remains a comparative judgment.
Assessment of classical transformations may vary with readers' linguistic and scholarly access.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ulitskaya's interwoven narratives bring moral seriousness and social amplitude to Soviet and post-Soviet history, joining dissent, belief and intimate lives in a distinctive novelistic vision.
assessment.attribution: Ludmila Ulitskaya alone can be cited for polyphonic fiction illuminating the ethical lives of individuals under the weight of twentieth-century history.
assessment.maturity: The named novels point to a mature, sustained body of work with both historical range and attention to particular human lives.
uncertainties: Translation necessarily mediates the texture and tonal distinctions of the Russian prose.
Further corpus-wide comparison is needed to determine whether the highest achievements are representative.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Michon's compressed prose grants obscure lives, artistic inheritance and historical fragments exceptional density, making narrative inquiry itself a source of force.
assessment.attribution: The citation should credit Pierre Michon alone for concentrated prose that remakes biography, art history and marginal lives into exacting fiction.
assessment.maturity: A comparatively compact oeuvre can still show maturity here: the representative work indicates remarkable consistency of pressure, control and imaginative reach.
uncertainties: The smaller scale of the corpus needs to be weighed against writers with longer and more various oeuvres.
The assessment relies in part on translations from French.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Al-Koni's desert cosmology connects Tuareg experience, ecology and metaphysical fiction in an imaginative territory unusually distinct within the modern novel.
assessment.attribution: Ibrahim al-Koni alone can be recognized for fiction that turns desert life and ecological constraint into a sustained philosophical and mythic vision.
assessment.maturity: The description identifies a substantial fictional project rather than a single emblematic work, suggesting durable achievement.
uncertainties: Translation and limited access to the full Arabic corpus make assessment of linguistic achievement provisional.
The range and internal development of the larger oeuvre require closer comparative consideration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Tawada makes bilingual estrangement a generative literary method, enlarging fiction and poetry through encounters among language, migration and nonhuman perspective.
assessment.attribution: The award would credit Yoko Tawada alone for an oeuvre that transforms linguistic displacement into inventive narrative and poetic form.
assessment.maturity: Her work spans several genres and two writing languages, providing a mature record of experimentation with a consistent central problem.
uncertainties: It is difficult to assess fully the relation between the Japanese and German bodies of work through translation.
The comparative durability of the formally diverse oeuvre warrants further discussion.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Zurita's large poetic sequences turn suffering, landscape and collective memory into daring memorial forms whose scale extends beyond private lyric.
assessment.attribution: Raúl Zurita alone can be cited for poetry that makes landscape-scale form an instrument of historical memory and collective address.
assessment.maturity: The representative sequences suggest a sustained poetic undertaking of unusual ambition and formal consequence.
uncertainties: Translation may not preserve the full sonic and visual organization of the Spanish poems.
The relation between public intervention and the autonomous literary force of the work needs careful comparative assessment.
